name: Academy Heavy Duty Stacking Medium Back Visitor Office Chair
sd: Stacking visitor chair with a padded medium back, rated for 8 hour use with a 130kg capacity. The armless version stacks up to six high for quick room changes, with a fabric or breathable nylon back, optional fixed arms and 20 bespoke colourways. Built to EN1335 and strength tested to ANSI/BIFMA standards.

name: Ace High Back Mesh Executive Office Chair with Folding Arms
sd: High back mesh executive office chair with folding arms, adjustable lumbar support and an adjustable headrest. A single lever lock tilt with weight tensioner and gas height adjustment keep setup simple, with a 110kg capacity rated for 8 hour use. Upholstered in black fabric or 20 bespoke colourways, including recycled Quest fabric.

name: Adjustable VESA Monitor Arms with USB and Audio Ports
sd: Fully adjustable monitor arms for 13 to 27 inch screens, fitting VESA 75 and 100 mounts and monitors from 2kg to 6.5kg. Reposition by hand within roughly a 50cm radius in a second, tilt, swivel and rotate to portrait, and plug into USB, audio and mic ports built into the base. Two widths, discreet cable management and a 2 year guarantee.

name: Advocate High Back Black Bonded Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: Black bonded leather executive office chair with a padded tri-panelled high backrest, chrome five star base and chrome arms finished with bonded leather sleeves. A single lever lock tilt with weight tensioner and gas height adjustment keep it simple to set up, rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg weight capacity.

name: Advocate Medium Back Bonded Leather and Chrome Visitor Chair
sd: Black bonded leather visitor chair with a padded tri-panelled medium back on a polished chrome frame. Fixed armrests finished with bonded leather sleeves keep visitors comfortable through long meetings, and the 115kg capacity and 8 hour usage rating make it a proper working chair for receptions, boardrooms and waiting areas.

name: Air 400mm High Acoustic Desktop Desk Divider Screen
sd: Acoustic desktop desk divider screen that adds privacy and takes the edge off open-plan noise. A 40cm high, 20mm thick fabric-upholstered panel with a pinnable surface, easy to fit to the desk in four widths from 120cm to 180cm, upholstered in a choice of 22 colours including the Quest and Rivet collections.

name: Air Back-to-Back Desk Acoustic Divider Screen
sd: Acoustic desk divider screen made for the Air back-to-back desk, fixing to the shared frame between facing workstations. The 80cm high, 20mm thick fabric-upholstered panel absorbs open-plan noise, gives each side a fully pinnable surface, and comes in four widths from 120cm to 180cm with 22 upholstery colours.

name: Air Back-to-Back Desk Cable Management Spine
sd: Cable management spine for Air back-to-back sit-stand desks, carrying power and data from floor to desktop in one tidy run. Oval segments flex as the desk rises and falls, a rotating desk fixing follows the movement, and a large weighted base keeps it stable. 132cm tall, in White, Black or Silver, with a 5 year guarantee.

name: Air Back-to-Back Electric Height Adjustable Bench Desk
sd: Electric height adjustable bench desk seating two, four or six people back-to-back. Dual motors cover a 66.5cm to 131.5cm height range with four memory settings, and each desk carries three UK plugs, USB, USB-C and two Cat 6 ports. Seven wood finishes, three frame colours and widths from 120cm to 180cm.

name: Air Back-to-Back Linking Bar for 1200-1600mm Desks
sd: Desk linking bar for joining Air back-to-back bench desk pods into longer runs, compatible with desk widths from 1200mm to 1600mm. A 25cm metal bar in white, black or silver, it lets a bank of sit-stand desks expand seamlessly as the team grows, and carries a 5 year guarantee.

name: Air Back-to-Back Linking Bar for 1800mm Desks
sd: Back-to-back linking bar for 1800mm desks, joining Air bench desk pods into one continuous run. A metal bar measuring 25cm by 20.5cm in white, black or silver, it expands a bank of sit-stand desks seamlessly as headcount grows, and carries a 5 year guarantee.

name: Air Back-to-Back Scalloped Edge Height Adjustable Bench Desk
sd: Height adjustable bench desk with a scalloped rear edge, seating two, four or six people back-to-back. Electric dual motors cover a 66.5cm to 131.5cm range with four memory settings, and each desk carries three UK plugs, USB, USB-C and two Cat 6 ports. Six finishes, three frame colours, widths to 160cm.

name: Air Dual Motor Electric Height Adjustable Standing Desk
sd: Electric height adjustable standing desk driven by smooth dual motors from 66.5cm to 131.5cm at 38mm per second, with 4 memory settings on a digital LED handset. A 120kg weight capacity, anti-collision sensor and USB port, in 4 widths from 120cm to 180cm, 2 depths, 7 finishes and 3 frame colours, with optional cable ports and modesty panel.

name: Air Electric Sit-Stand Height Adjustable Desk Leg Frame
sd: Electric height adjustable desk leg frame with smooth dual motors, a 660mm to 1310mm height range and four programmable memory settings. The Air sit-stand frame on its own, in white, black or silver steel, rated to 120kg with an anti-trap safety stop, digital LED display and 10 year structural guarantee.

name: Air Height Adjustable Desk Cable Management Spine
sd: Cable management spine for Air height adjustable desks, guiding power and data leads neatly from floor to desktop at every height. Oval segments flex as the desk rises and falls, a large weighted base keeps it planted, and it comes in white, black or silver with a 5 year guarantee.

name: Air Lite Height Adjustable Standing Desk with Cable Ports
sd: Electric height adjustable standing desk with built-in cable ports, a quiet single motor and 3 memory settings on a digital LED handset. Rises from 70cm to 114cm at 22mm per second, with a 70kg weight capacity and anti-trap safety stop. Four widths from 100cm to 160cm, two depths, 7 wood finishes and 3 frame colours.

name: Air Lite Scalloped Edge Height Adjustable Standing Desk
sd: Electric height adjustable standing desk with a scalloped rear edge that gives leads a clean route off the back of the desk. A quiet single motor rises from 70cm to 114cm with 3 memory settings on a digital LED handset, a 70kg weight capacity and an anti-trap safety stop. Three widths from 120cm to 160cm, 6 wood finishes and 3 frame colours.

name: Air Piste Electric Height Adjustable Standing Desk
sd: Electric height adjustable standing desk on distinctive triangular Piste feet, built for stability with a look to match. Dual motors rise from 66.5cm to 131.5cm at 38mm per second with 4 memory settings, a 120kg capacity and an anti-collision sensor. Four widths, two depths, 7 finishes and 3 frame colours, plus optional cable ports.

name: Air Pump Lumbar Support for Office Chairs
sd: Office chair lumbar support adjusted by a simple air pump, designed to improve posture and look after the lower back. Add air for firmer support exactly where your spine wants it, or let a little out for a softer feel. A small, sensible upgrade for anyone whose chair is not quite supporting them, covered by a 1 year guarantee.

name: Air Scalloped Edge Electric Height Adjustable Standing Desk
sd: Electric height adjustable standing desk with a scalloped rear edge for clean cable runs and smooth dual motors. Rises from 66.5cm to 131.5cm at 38mm per second with 4 memory settings, a 120kg weight capacity, anti-collision sensor and lockable handset. Three widths at a full 80cm depth, 6 wood finishes and 3 frame colours.

name: Air Steel Under Desk Modesty Panel
sd: Steel desk modesty panel that fixes straight to the underside of the desktop, so it rises and falls with a sit-stand desk and keeps privacy at any height. A sleek 100cm wide, 50cm high panel in White, Black or Silver, suitable for height adjustable and standard desks alike, with a 5 year guarantee.

name: Air Triangular Piste Desk Foot Accessory Set of 2
sd: Triangular piste feet for the Air single height adjustable desk frame, sold as a set of two. A show stopping ski-style upgrade in white, black or silver metal that brings enhanced stability as well as looks, each foot 60cm deep and 46.2cm high, with a 5 year guarantee. Not for the back-to-back frame.

name: Air Universal Deep Under Desk Cable Tray
sd: Deep under desk cable tray that fixes straight to the desktop, keeping leads hidden and organised without restricting a sit stand desk's height adjustment. Sturdy metal basket, 80cm wide and 17.4cm deep, in white, black or silver with a 5 year guarantee. Suits Air height adjustable and standard desks alike.

name: Anti Fatigue Floor Mat for Standing Desks and Workstations
sd: Anti fatigue floor mat in soft high density PU that cushions long spells of standing at a sit-stand desk or industrial workstation. A 99cm by 51cm surface, 1.9cm thick, with a textured anti-slip finish and bevelled edges to prevent tripping. Relieves pressure on feet, joints and the lower back, and is easy to keep clean.

name: Ariel Mesh Back Task Operator Office Chair with Loop Arms
sd: Breathable mesh back task operator chair with built-in lumbar shaping, fixed loop arms and a curved shell detail. Gas height adjustment, lock tilt and a weight tensioner tune it to how you sit, rated for 8 hour use with a 150kg capacity. Four colourways, Black, Blue, Grey and Red, suit home offices and shared spaces alike.

name: Astro Medium Mesh Back Cantilever Visitor Chair
sd: Mesh back cantilever visitor chair with curves in all the right places. A breathable medium mesh back, generous upholstered seat and fixed arms sit on a sturdy cantilever frame rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg capacity. Upholstered in black fabric or 20 bespoke colourways, including recycled Quest fabric.

name: Austin Heavy Duty Black PU Task Operator Office Chair
sd: Heavy duty task operator office chair with a 205kg weight capacity and an executive cushioned profile in black PU leather. A high back with fixed headrest, gas height adjustment, lock tilt and a weight tensioner keep serious sitters supported through an 8 hour day, on a build that stays solid in constant use.

name: Banqueting Deep Cushioned Fabric Stacking Conference Chair
sd: Fabric stacking chair for conferences, meetings, banquets and events, with a deep padded seat on a strong steel frame. Rated for 8 hour use with a 115kg weight capacity, it weighs just 6kg and stacks away neatly between bookings. Upholstered in a choice of black or blue fabric to suit the room.

name: Barcelona Deluxe High Back 24 Hour Task Operator Office Chair
sd: High back task operator office chair rated for 24 hour use with a 158kg weight capacity. A ratchet height adjustable backrest, independent seat and back angles, seat slide, multi adjustable arms and a weight tensioner fit it to any user, with smart stitch detailing in black fabric, black leather or blue.

name: Baye High Mesh Back Black Faux Leather Task Operator Office Chair
sd: High mesh back task operator chair pairing breathable black mesh with faux leather upholstery, a chrome base and a distinctive boomerang arm design. Integral lumbar support, single lever lock tilt, gas height adjustment and a weight tensioner, rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg capacity and tested to ANSI/BIFMA standard.

name: Bella Medium Back Black Bonded Leather Cantilever Visitor Chair
sd: Black bonded leather cantilever visitor chair with executive styling at a budget price. A contoured medium back with sculpted shoulder and head support, stitch-detailed upholstery and tough fixed armrests on a robust black cantilever frame. Rated for 8 hour use with a 120kg capacity. Ideal for meeting rooms, receptions and waiting areas.

name: Bella Medium Back Executive Office Chair with Arms
sd: Budget executive office chair with a panelled medium height back and a defined lumbar curve for proper lower back support. A lockable tilt action, gas height adjustment and weight tensioner let you set it up to suit you, rated for 8 hour use with a 125kg capacity. Choose black fabric, black leather or charcoal upholstery.

name: Black Ice Glass Height Adjustable Standing Desk with Wireless Charging
sd: Height adjustable standing desk with a sleek black glass top, touch screen controls and built-in wireless phone charging. Glides from 71cm to 119cm at 40mm per second with memory height settings, plus two USB ports and a USB-C port integrated into the desktop. Carbon steel frame, 60kg capacity and a 5 year guarantee.

name: Black Nylon 5-Star Office Chair Base
sd: Replacement office chair base in tough black nylon. The five-arm star design is rated to a 125kg maximum weight capacity, ready to bring a tired swivel chair straight back into service; castors and gas lift are sold separately. Backed by a 1 year guarantee on mechanical components.

name: Black Ventilated Laptop and Tablet Cradle for Monitor Arms
sd: Ventilated laptop and tablet cradle that fixes a laptop securely to a monitor arm, lifting it to proper screen height. The innovative one-piece design works with Easy Adjust arms, holds tablets too, and its ventilated construction keeps the machine cool while it works. Lightweight black plastic, safety compliant, with a 1 year guarantee.

name: Boho Forest Green Soft Seating Accent Chair
sd: Forest green accent chair that brings soft seating warmth to breakout spaces, receptions and quiet corners. Handcrafted with a distinctive three-leg design, upholstered fixed armrests and a deep-cushioned 48cm wide seat, it carries a 125kg weight capacity, a 5 hour usage rating and a 5 year frame guarantee.

name: Brayford Linen Fabric Bistro Bar Stool with Backrest
sd: Bistro bar stool with a gently curved seat and backrest in soft linen fabric, on a strong steel frame with an integral footrest. A 65cm seat height suits bar and bistro tables, with a 110kg weight capacity and a choice of Blue or Oatmeal upholstery for cafes, canteens and social spaces.

name: Brixworth 1 to 3 Seater Open Office Privacy Booth
sd: Open office privacy booth for individual work, calls and quieter moments, UK manufactured from sustainable and premium materials. The Brixworth Open Booth seats 1, 2 or 3, its open yet defined structure giving privacy without isolation, with high-density eco-friendly foam and 48 colourways on a black or white frame.

name: Brixworth 1200mm Oblong Coffee Table with Weighted Disc Base
sd: Oblong coffee table with a 1200mm by 600mm laminate top on a weighted disc base. name: Brixworth Acoustic Office Privacy Bench Booth
sd: Acoustic booth seating for open plan offices, UK manufactured from sustainable materials. The Brixworth Bench Booth gives meetings, calls and focused work a quiet retreat, upholstered in high-density eco-friendly foam, in 2, 4 and 6 seater sizes with 48 upholstery colourways on a black or white frame.

name: Brixworth Black Frame Office Privacy Booth with Table
sd: Office privacy booth with an integrated table on a black frame, UK manufactured from sustainable materials. The Brixworth seats 2, 4 or 6 with a 48cm by 60cm table in black or white, with high-density eco-friendly foam and 48 upholstery colourways for focused discussions and working catch-ups.

name: Brixworth Booth Monitor Mounting Bracket for Office Pods
sd: Monitor mounting bracket designed for Brixworth booth and pod setups. Holds a screen securely at a comfortable viewing height inside the pod, freeing up worktop space for video calls, focused work and shared screen sessions. Discreet in design, quick to install and built for daily use in busy collaboration zones.

name: Brixworth Fully Enclosed Acoustic Office Privacy Booth
sd: Fully enclosed acoustic office booth, UK manufactured from sustainable materials. The Brixworth Booth turns meetings, calls and shared tasks into a quiet retreat from a busy floor, upholstered in high-density eco-friendly foam, with 2, 4 or 6 seats, 48 upholstery colourways and a black or white frame.

name: Brixworth Modular Seating Linking Brackets Set of 2
sd: Modular seating linking brackets that keep Brixworth units securely connected, sold as a set of 2. Discreet silver steel plates that fix into holes pre-drilled in the seat, holding sofas and benches firmly in line even in high-traffic areas. Simply lift the seat to separate units and rearrange the layout.

name: Brixworth Office Privacy Bench Booth with Table
sd: Office booth seating with an integrated table, UK manufactured from sustainable materials. The Brixworth Bench Booth with Table pairs seating for 2, 4 or 6 with a 48cm by 60cm table for working sessions, brainstorms and coffee catch-ups, in high-density eco-friendly foam with 48 colourways and a black or white frame and table.

name: Brixworth Round Coffee Table with Weighted Cross Base
sd: Round coffee table on a weighted cross base, with a 20mm laminate top in a 60cm or 80cm diameter. A softly bevelled edge lightens the top, black or white finishes pair with a black or white frame, and low or medium heights suit sofas or café seating. 100kg capacity and a 10 year guarantee.

name: Brixworth Round Coffee Table with Weighted Disc Base
sd: Round coffee table on a weighted 580mm disc base, with a 20mm laminate top in a 60cm or 80cm diameter. The softly bevelled edge draws a fine shadow line around the rim, and black or white tops, black or white frames and low or medium heights cover most rooms. 100kg capacity, 10 year guarantee.

name: Brixworth Square Coffee Table with Weighted Cross Base
sd: Square coffee table on a weighted cross base, with a 20mm laminate top in a 60cm or 80cm width. The softly bevelled edge takes the hardness off the square, black or white tops sit over a black or white frame, and low or medium heights suit sofas or café chairs. 100kg capacity, 10 year guarantee.

name: Brixworth Square Coffee Table with Weighted Disc Base
sd: Square coffee table on a weighted 580mm disc base, with a 20mm laminate top 60cm or 80cm wide. A softly bevelled edge softens the corners and lightens the surface, with black or white tops, black or white frames and low or medium heights to choose from. 100kg capacity and a 10 year guarantee.

name: Brixworth UK Crafted 2 and 3 Seater Office Sofa
sd: Office sofa crafted in the UK from sustainable materials, available as a 2 seater or 3 seater. Clean lines and a welcoming, adaptable shape for receptions, breakout zones and collaborative spaces, upholstered in 24 colourways across four fabric collections and finished on a black or white frame.

name: Brixworth UK Crafted Modular Office Seating Unit
sd: Modular seating unit crafted in the UK using sustainable materials, available as a central, corner, left or right unit to build sofas, corners and full breakout landscapes. Upholstered in 24 fabric colourways across four collections, on a black or white frame, for workplaces, hospitality and public spaces.

name: Brixworth UK Crafted Soft Seating Reception Armchair
sd: UK crafted armchair that brings soft seating character to reception areas, breakout zones and quiet corners. A standalone design built with sustainable materials for lasting service, upholstered in a choice of 24 colourways across four fabric collections and finished on a black or white frame.

name: Brixworth White Frame Office Privacy Booth with Table
sd: Office privacy booth with an integrated table on a white frame, UK manufactured from sustainable materials. Seating for 2, 4 or 6 in 48 upholstery colourways, a 48cm by 60cm table in black or white on a silver or white leg, and high-density eco-friendly foam for meetings and quiet working sessions.

name: Brunswick Deluxe Deep Cushioned Stacking Visitor Chair with Arms
sd: Stacking visitor chair with a deeply cushioned seat, generous backrest and wave shaped polyurethane armrests. Choose a fabric or breathable mesh back, a black or chrome frame, optional castors and 20 bespoke colourways. Stacks four high without castors, with a 115kg capacity and a 6 hour usage rating.

name: Brunswick Deluxe Office Chair Castors Set of 5
sd: Office chair castors that convert the Brunswick Deluxe from a static seat into a mobile one, sold as a set of 5. Hardwearing twin wheeled castors in tough metal and plastic, supporting up to 125kg and letting the chair roll freely around any environment. Covered by a 1 year guarantee.

name: Brunswick Medium Back Stacking Visitor Office Chair
sd: Uncomplicated stacking visitor chair with an upholstered seat and medium back on a hard-wearing black or chrome frame. Optional fixed arms, 20 bespoke colourways, and armless chairs stack neatly for storage. At 8kg it moves easily, with a 115kg capacity and an 8 hour usage rating.

name: Camden Medium Back Black Mesh Task Operator Office Chair
sd: Medium back mesh task operator chair with a breathable black mesh back, seat depth adjustment and gas height adjustment. Rated for 8 hour use with a 120kg capacity and certified to BS7176 medium hazard, with a seat in black or 20 bespoke colourways including recycled Quest fabric. Fixed arms come off if you prefer.

name: Capra Mesh Back Folding Office Training Chair with Sliding Arms
sd: Folding training chair with a breathable mesh back that automatically matches its tilt tension to whoever sits in it. Sliding arm pads, an optional 330 x 230mm writing tablet and 20 bespoke colourways, with a 150kg weight capacity and a frame that folds flat the moment the room needs clearing.

name: Carmen Solid Timber Frame Fabric Visitor Chair with Arms
sd: Fabric visitor chair on a solid timber frame, with a double curvature back, integral shaped armrests and a waterfall seat edge that takes the pressure off the thighs. Floor protectors as standard, 13 upholstery colourways, a 125kg weight capacity and a 6 hour usage rating for offices, receptions and meeting rooms.

name: Carmen Wooden Frame Fabric High Bar Stool with Arms
sd: Wooden bar stool with a fabric seat and back on a solid timber frame, with integral fixed armrests and a waterfall seat edge. An 80cm seat height suits high tables and counters, rated for 6 hour use with a 125kg capacity and upholstered in 13 colourways including the Rivet collection.

name: Carter High Back Black Faux Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: High back executive office chair in black faux leather with stitch detailing, deep foams and a waterfall seat front. A chrome five star base and matching chrome arms with padded sleeves carry the luxury look, with a lockable tilt, weight tension control and gas height adjustment. Rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg capacity.

name: Carter Medium Back Black Faux Leather Cantilever Visitor Chair
sd: Black faux leather cantilever visitor chair offering luxury at a fraction of the usual cost. Stitch detailing, deep foam cushioning and padded arm sleeves on a polished chrome cantilever frame, with a waterfall seat front that eases pressure on the thighs. Rated for 8 hour use with a 115kg weight capacity.

name: Charford PU Leather Bistro Bar Stool with Backrest
sd: Bistro bar stool with a contoured PU leather seat that wipes clean in seconds, on a strong steel frame with an integrated footrest. A 64cm seat height suits cafe counters and high tables, with a 110kg weight capacity and a choice of Black or Brown upholstery.

name: Chelsea High Back Soft Black Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: High back black leather executive office chair with a throne-like design: wide gull wing armrests, deep cushioning and contrasting piping detail in soft bonded leather with chrome. A lock tilt with weight tensioner and gas height adjustment handle the comfort, rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg weight capacity.

name: Chester Boutique Dark Oak Rectangular Home Office Desk with Drawer Storage
sd: Boutique rectangular office desk in warm dark oak, accented with a varnished brass style frame and design details. name: Chesterfield Button Tufted High Back Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: Traditional executive office chair with a button tufted high backrest, leather faced with deep cushioning, soft padded wooden armrests and a matching wooden five star base. A lock tilt with weight tension adjustment and gas height adjustment handle the comfort, rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg capacity. In brown, burgundy or green leather.

name: Chiro Height Adjustable Foldaway Office Chair Arm
sd: Height adjustable office chair arm for the Chiro range with an ingenious foldaway action: flip it back on its silver hinge plate for close-up desk work, flip it down again for complete arm support. Black nylon construction, removable, and covered by a 1 year guarantee.

name: Chiro Height Adjustable Office Chair Arm
sd: Height adjustable office chair arm for the Chiro range with a padded arm pad for comfortable elbow support at the desk. Strength and endurance tested to ANSI/BIFMA X5.1-2017, made from tough black nylon, fully removable, and covered by a 1 year guarantee.

name: Chiro Medium or High Back Ergonomic 24 Hour Task Operator Chair
sd: Ergonomic 24 hour task operator chair with a choice of medium or high ratchet height adjustable back, pump adjustable lumbar support and independent seat and back tilt. Seat slide, seat angle and gas height adjustment, a 150kg weight capacity, four arm options and 22 fabric colourways including recycled Quest.

name: Chiro Plus High Back Ergonomic 24 Hour Posture Office Chair
sd: Chiropractor-approved ergonomic office chair with a height adjustable high back, adjustable lumbar support and optional headrest. Rated for 24 hour use with a 150kg weight capacity, synchronised tilt, seat slide and multi-adjustable arms. Upholstered in stock fabrics, leather or 20 bespoke colourways, including recycled Quest fabric.

name: Chrome 5-Star Office Chair Base
sd: Office chair base in a classic 5-star design, finished in elegant chrome and rated to a 150kg maximum weight capacity. The smart way to refresh a tired chair or add a polished look to a new build. Castors and gas lift are sold separately. Covered by a 1 year guarantee.

name: Classic Medium Back Bonded Leather Cantilever Visitor Chair
sd: Bonded leather cantilever visitor chair in black, tan or white with generous, deeply padded seating for day long comfort. Appealing chrome details run throughout, from the padded upholstered arms to the cantilever frame. Rated for 8 hour use with a 115kg capacity, and made to match the Classic range of executive chairs.

name: Classic Medium or High Back Bonded Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: Contemporary executive office chair in soft bonded leather with bright chrome detailing throughout. Choose a medium or high backrest in black, tan or white, on castors or chrome glides. A two lever infinite lock holds the recline at any angle, with a weight tensioner and gas height adjustment. 125kg capacity, rated for 8 hour use.

name: Cosmo Hi Rise Draughtsman Chair with Adjustable Footrest
sd: Designer draughtsman chair for drafting tables and standing-height desks, with a 60cm to 78cm gas lift seat and a height adjustable footrest. The backrest tilts with automatic weight tensioning, the materials are GRS certified 100% recycled plastic, and 21 upholstery colours pair with 4 frame colours. Rated for 8 hour use, 120kg capacity.

name: Cosmo Recycled Plastic Cantilever Meeting Chair
sd: Cantilever meeting chair with a responsive frame that flexes naturally as you sit, creating a gentle rocking motion that keeps conversations relaxed. name: Cosmo Recycled Plastic Task Operator Office Chair
sd: Task operator office chair made with GRS certified 100% recycled plastic materials, with a breathable back, auto tilting backrest and auto weight tension control. Gas lift, 360 degree swivel, a 120kg capacity and 21 fabric colourways across four frame colours, backed by a 5 year mechanical guarantee.

name: Cosmo Training and Conference Meeting Room Chair
sd: Training and conference chair built for rooms that change layout by the hour. Rated for 6 hour use with a 120kg capacity.

name: Crew 2 Mesh Back Task Operator Office Chair with Folding Arms
sd: Mesh back task operator chair made for work that keeps pace: a breathable medium mesh back with integral lumbar support, folding arms, lock tilt, weight tensioner and gas lift. GRS certified 100% recycled plastic materials, a 150kg capacity, 8 hour rating and 21 fabric colourways including recycled Quest.

name: Crew Medium Mesh Back Task Operator Office Chair with Folding Arms
sd: Medium mesh back task operator chair full of character, with folding arms that clear the desk, a single lever lock tilt mechanism, weight tensioner and gas height adjustment. Rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg capacity, light at 9.5kg, and upholstered in black or 20 bespoke colourways including recycled Quest.

name: Dakota High Back Black Leather-Look Executive Office Chair
sd: High back executive office chair in wipe-clean black leather-look upholstery, soft to the touch, with contrast stitching detail and lumbar shaping to the back. Fully upholstered arms with highlight silver styling, a lock and tilt action with weight tensioner, and gas height adjustment. 120kg capacity, rated for 8 hour use.

name: Dallas Pillow Top High Back Leather-Look Executive Office Chair
sd: High back executive office chair with pillow top cushions on both seat and backrest, finished in wipe-clean black leather-look upholstery with detail stitching. Padded chrome armrests and a matching chrome wheelbase, a single lever lock or tilt mechanism with tension control, and gas height adjustment. 120kg capacity, rated for 8 hour use.

name: Denver Black High Mesh Back Task Operator Office Chair
sd: High mesh back task operator office chair in black with a synchronised tilt mechanism, anti-shock and weight tensioner. Height adjustable lumbar support, height adjustable arms and a seat slide fit it to any user, with an optional angle adjustable headrest. Rated for 8 hour use with a 120kg capacity, for office or home.

name: Denver Height Adjustable Office Chair Headrest
sd: Height adjustable office chair headrest for the Denver range, upholstered in black fabric to match the chair. A 29cm wide cushion that raises or lowers to meet the back of your head, adding proper neck support for office and home working alike. 3 year guarantee on mechanical components.

name: Design Soft Seating Power Module with USB and Mains Sockets
sd: Integrated power module for soft seating and breakout areas, bringing mains plug sockets and USB-A and USB-C charging right to the seat. name: Desire Medium Back Bonded Leather Cantilever Visitor Chair
sd: Bonded leather cantilever visitor chair with a deep-cushioned split panel backrest, soft padded arms and a polished chrome cantilever frame. name: Desire Split Panel Leather Executive Office Chair in Black or White
sd: Executive office chair in soft bonded leather with a deep-cushioned split panel backrest, polished chrome five star base and soft padded arms. name: Domino High Back Ergonomic 24 Hour Posture Office Chair with Headrest
sd: High back ergonomic posture office chair rated for 24 hour use with a 145kg weight capacity. name: Dura Medium Nylon Back Task Operator Office Chair
sd: Task operator office chair with a flexible curved nylon backrest in seven colours and a breathable air-mesh fabric seat in 21 colourways, for combinations to suit any office. Single lever lock and tilt, weight tensioner and chrome gas lift on a 5 star base, rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg capacity.

name: Dynamic Clear Office Chair Mat for Carpet and Hard Floors
sd: Clear office chair mat in durable PVC that shields carpet, hardwood, laminate and tile from castor scratches, dents and wheel marks while letting the floor show through. name: Echo Medium Back Leather Stackable Cantilever Visitor Chair with Arms
sd: Leather cantilever visitor chair with a panelled all-in-one shell, curved chrome frame and fixed arms with PU armpads. name: Mawsley Two or Three Seater Modular Office Sofa

name: Metro Medium Mesh Back Stacking Visitor Chair with Arms

name: Metropolis High Back Black Leather Look Executive Office Chair
sd: High back executive office chair in soft, wipe clean black leather look upholstery with stitching detail, deep padding and fully upholstered arms. name: Mien High Back Leather Executive Cantilever Visitor Chair
sd: High back leather cantilever visitor chair with sumptuous executive styling. A tall shaped backrest in soft bonded leather, polished aluminium fixed arms with PU armpads and a chrome cantilever frame. Rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg weight capacity, in black or black and mink.

name: Mien High Back Soft Bonded Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: High back executive office chair in soft bonded leather with a tall shaped backrest, chrome metal five star base and fixed arms with PU pads. name: Milan Black Vinyl Folding Conference and Visitor Chair
sd: Folding visitor and conference chair with a cushioned, wipe-clean black vinyl seat and back on a chrome tubular steel frame. Rated for 8 hour use with a 115kg weight capacity, it folds flat for minimal storage, carries by an integral handle, and comes with or without a writing table.

name: Milan Right Hand Foldaway Writing Table for Folding Chairs
sd: Foldaway chair writing table for the Milan folding chair, with a durable wipe clean polymer surface, an integrated fold-out pen tray and cup holder, and a tilting, swivel-away action for easy access. name: Mimi Light Grey Bouclé 3 Seater Curved Office Sofa
sd: Curved 3 seater office sofa in light grey bouclé fabric, 220cm wide with a generous 185cm seat. A natural centrepiece for receptions and lounges.

name: Mirage II All Mesh Task Operator Office Chair with Adjustable Arms
sd: All mesh task operator office chair with a sprung mesh seat and back, integral lumbar support, a seat slide and a synchronised reclining action with anti-shock and infinite lock. name: Mirage II Black Mesh Office Chair Headrest
sd: Black mesh office chair headrest for the Mirage II mesh back chair. name: Mode Black Bonded Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: Black bonded leather executive office chair on a polished aluminium frame, with integral lumbar support and a cushioned medium backrest. Synchro tilt with an auto tensioner and anti-shock, plus gas height adjustment from 43cm to 53cm. Rated for 8 hour use with a 160kg maximum weight capacity.

name: Moore Deluxe High Back Black Executive Office Chair with Chrome Base
sd: High back executive office chair in soft bonded leather, traditional in style and luxurious in feel, with the Deluxe chrome five star base and chrome arm detail. name: Moore Deluxe High Back Cantilever Visitor Chair with Padded Arms
sd: High back cantilever visitor chair, traditional in style and luxurious in feel. Generous cushioning on the seat and back, upholstered panels with distinctive lines, matching fixed padded arms and a choice of black or chrome cantilever frame. Rated for 8 hour use with a 115kg weight capacity, in black fabric or black leather.

name: Moore High Back Black Executive Office Chair in Fabric or Leather
sd: High back executive office chair from a popular traditional range, upholstered in black fabric or soft bonded leather with generous cushioning on seat and back. name: Neo Round Black Upholstered Coffee Table
sd: Round upholstered coffee table finished in black fabric or soft bonded leather to match the Neo tub chairs. name: Neo Round Glass Coffee Table Top
sd: Round glass coffee table top for the Neo upholstered reception table, supplied on its own. name: Neo Single Seater Black Office Reception Tub Chair
sd: Traditional black tub chair for reception areas, waiting rooms and breakout spaces, upholstered in soft bonded leather or fabric. name: Neo Twin Seater Black Office Reception Tub Sofa
sd: Twin seater tub sofa in black bonded leather or fabric, seating two visitors in a 123cm frame. name: Nest Edge Stacking Polypropylene Canteen and Dining Chair
sd: Stacking canteen and dining chair in tough polypropylene with a 150kg weight capacity and a 5 year guarantee. name: Nest Loop Stacking Cafe Bistro Canteen and Dining Chair
sd: Stacking cafe and bistro chair for canteens and dining areas, moulded in tough polypropylene with a 150kg weight capacity. name: Nexus High Back Ergonomic Task Operator Office Chair with Headrest
sd: Ergonomic task operator office chair that does the lot: pump up adjustable lumbar support, a height adjustable high back and headrest, a seat slide with seat angle adjustment, and removable height adjustable arms. name: Nola Italian Inspired Leather Cantilever Visitor Chair with Arms
sd: Leather cantilever visitor chair with Italian-inspired styling straight from Milan. A curved seat and back with stitching detail, chrome-detailed fixed arms and a sprung chrome cantilever frame with floor protectors. Rated for 8 hour use with a 120kg weight capacity, in black or white leather.

name: Nola Italian Style Leather Executive Office Chair in Black or White
sd: Bonded leather executive office chair with classic Italian styling: a curved seat and back, stitching detail and chrome on the frame, base and arms. name: Office Chair Glides Set of 5 in Black or Chrome
sd: Office chair glides that swap rolling castors for planted stability, sold as a set of 5 in a black or chrome finish. Attractive polyacrylic pads with a flat, smooth base that stop the chair moving while you are seated, yet let it slide easily into place when you are not. 1 year guarantee.

name: Office Chair Seat Slide Mechanism with M6 Fixing Bolts
sd: Office chair seat slide mechanism that converts many chairs, including many Dynamic models, to a sliding seat facility. Metal and plastic build in black, 1 year guarantee.

name: Olive High Back Executive Office Chair with Wood Effect Detailing
sd: High back executive office chair in black or brown PU vegan leather with integrated wooden effect detailing, a timeless design given a modern twist. High-density poured foam cushioning, refined knee tilt reclining with tension adjustment and fixed armrests. Rated for 8 hour use with a 150kg weight capacity.

name: Ontario High Back Executive Office Chair with Pillow Top Cushions
sd: High back executive office chair with pillow top cushions on a generously sized seat and backrest, in wipe clean black leather look upholstery with chrome detail. A single lever lock or tilt mechanism with tension control and anti-shock, plus padded arms with silver accents. Rated for 8 hour use with a 120kg capacity.

name: Onyx High Back Ergonomic Posture Office Chair with Adjustable Arms
sd: High back ergonomic posture office chair with a triple lever mechanism giving independent seat and back angle adjustment, a ratchet backrest, pump up lumbar support and seat slide. Contoured foam seat and back, height adjustable arms, brushed aluminium base. Rated for 24 hour use, 135kg capacity, optional headrest, 22 upholstery choices.

name: Orbit High Mesh Back Task Operator Office Chair with Flip Up Arms
sd: Mesh back office chair with a breathable high back, adjustable lumbar support and a generously padded 54cm wide seat. Rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg capacity, in 21 upholstery colours.

name: Orlena High Back Ergonomic Task Operator Office Chair
sd: High back ergonomic task chair where every key dimension adjusts independently: seat height, seat depth, backrest height, lumbar support and tilt. name: Oscar High Back Black Faux Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: High back executive office chair swathed in soft touch black faux leather, with a luxuriously deep multi panel seat and back, ergonomic headrest panel and big fixed armrests with supple pads. Anti-shock knee tilt with synchronised tilt and lock action and tension control. Rated for 8 hour use with a 120kg capacity.

name: Oslo 1600mm Square Boardroom Table Extension Kit
sd: Boardroom table extension kit that adds a matching 1600mm x 1600mm section to the Oslo square meeting table. The same white 25mm top with protective 2mm ABS edge, wooden legs with a white frame and floor levellers, plus an optional pop-up power module with sockets, USB, HDMI and wireless charging. 100kg capacity, minimalist Oslo lines.

name: Oslo 1600mm Square Wooden Leg Boardroom Table
sd: Square boardroom meeting table from the minimalist Oslo range. name: Oslo Air Back-to-Back Height Adjustable Bench Desk for 2, 4 or 6 People
sd: Back-to-back height adjustable bench desk for 2, 4 or 6 people, pairing electric sit-stand desks in one white bench. name: Oslo Air Electric Height Adjustable Standing Desk
sd: Electric height adjustable standing desk from the minimalist Oslo bench family, with a floating white and natural wood top on a white frame. name: Oslo Air Piste Height Adjustable Office Desk
sd: The Piste legs are electrically height adjustable, moving from sitting to standing at the touch of a button. The bench concept saves budget and space.

name: Oslo Back-to-Back Bench Desk Cable Management Tray

name: Oslo Back-to-Back Bench Desk Extension Kit for Two Workstations
sd: Bench desk extension kit adding a back-to-back pair of workstations to an existing Oslo bench. name: Oslo Back-to-Back Bench Desks and Workstations for 2, 4 or 6 People
sd: Back-to-back bench desk workstations seating 2, 4 or 6 people across two facing rows. White 25mm MFC desktops on wooden legs with a natural wood finish, desk widths of 120cm, 140cm or 160cm, and a choice of natural wood or white edging. 100kg weight capacity and a 10 year guarantee.

name: Oslo Large Rectangular Wooden Leg Boardroom Table
sd: Large rectangular boardroom meeting table from the minimalist Oslo range, 3200mm or 4800mm long and a generous 1600mm deep. Bench-style design, boardroom scale.

name: Oslo Oval Wooden Leg Boardroom Meeting Table
sd: Oval boardroom meeting table from the minimalist Oslo range, with a softly rounded D-end top on wooden legs with a white frame. name: Oslo Single Row Bench Desk Extension Kit for One Extra Workstation
sd: Bench desk extension kit that adds one workstation to an existing Oslo single row bench. name: Oslo Single Row White Bench Desk Workstation for 2 or 3 People
sd: Single row bench desk workstation seating 2 or 3 people side by side. White 25mm MFC tops with a scalloped back edge for easy cable dumping and a protective 2mm ABS edge, on wooden legs with floor levellers. Desk widths of 120cm, 140cm or 160cm, a 100kg weight capacity and a 10 year guarantee.

name: Oslo Single Starter White Bench Desk Workstation for One Person
sd: Single person bench desk workstation that starts an Oslo bench run or stands alone as a minimalist white desk. Widths of 120cm, 140cm or 160cm, a 100kg weight capacity and a 10 year guarantee.

name: Palma All Mesh Medium Back Task Operator Office Chair with Arms
sd: All mesh task operator office chair with matching breathable mesh across seat and backrest for a suspended, supported sit. Height adjustable lumbar support, a single lever lock tilt with weight tension control and soft-padded height adjustable arms, on a matching black nylon 5 star base. Rated for 8 hour use with a 125kg weight capacity.

name: Penza High Back Leather and Chrome Executive Office Chair
sd: High back executive office chair upholstered in soft bonded leather with panelled cushioning and smart stitching detail. A twin lever mechanism reclines and locks at any angle, with weight tilt tension control, on a polished chrome base with matching padded arms. Rated for 8 hour use with a 110kg capacity, in black or grey leather.

name: Phoebe Cream Bouclé Curved Office Sofa
sd: Curved office sofa in luxurious cream bouclé, 199cm wide with a deep 61cm seat and high sweeping arms that cocoon the sitter. name: Phoebe Cream Bouclé Soft Seating Footstool
sd: Cream bouclé footstool from the Phoebe soft seating collection, upholstered to match the curved sofa and swivel armchair. A plush 58.5cm square cushioned top on a solid frame takes feet up in comfort or serves as occasional seating, with a 125kg capacity and a 5 year frame guarantee.

name: Phoebe Cream Bouclé Swivel Office Accent Chair
sd: Swivel accent chair in cream bouclé with a full 360 degree turn, plush cushioning and a curved back that wraps into the arms. Part of the Phoebe soft seating collection alongside the matching curved sofa and footstool, with a 125kg capacity and a 5 year frame guarantee for lounges and receptions.

name: Phoenix Cash Deposit Front Loading Office Security Safe
sd: Front loading cash deposit security safe for 24 hour cash management, rated for overnight cover of £3,000 cash or £30,000 valuables. A 12mm steel plate door and 6mm body with an anti-fishing baffle plate, night lockout plate, and a choice of electronic, fingerprint or key locking across two sizes.

name: Phoenix Cashier Day Deposit Under Counter Cash Security Safe
sd: Under counter day deposit security safe that takes cash straight from the till drawer through a front loading, lockable deposit. Rated for overnight cover of £1,000 cash or £10,000 valuables, with a tilting anti-fishing baffle plate, a double bitted key lock, a 6mm steel door and fixing bolts supplied for floor or wall.

name: Phoenix Commercial Wall Mounted Key Cabinet for 42 to 600 Keys
sd: Wall mounted commercial key cabinet in seven sizes, from 42 to 600 key hooks, with adjustable hook bars and number labels to keep every set accounted for. name: Phoenix Compact Home and Office Security Safe
sd: Compact security safe for home or office valuables, rated for overnight cover of £1,000 cash or £10,000 valuables. Twin live locking bolts and concealed internal hinges, a choice of digital lock with key override or straightforward key lock, and fixing bolts supplied for brick walls and concrete floors.

name: Phoenix Cygnus Electronic Key Deposit Safe for 30 to 700 Keys
sd: Electronic key deposit safe in six sizes from 30 to 700 key hooks, with a deposit slot for posting keys in without opening the door. Anti-tamper solenoid locking with a key override and two keys supplied, wall fixing bolts included, and a selection of coloured key rings in the box. Scratch resistant white finish.

name: Phoenix Data Commander 120 Minute Fireproof Data Safe
sd: Fireproof data safe with large capacity for backup tapes and computer media, tested to the Swedish NT Fire 017 120dis standard for 120 minutes of fire protection. Guarantee: Free Lifetime 'After the Fire' Replacement Warranty

name: Phoenix Datacare Home and Office Fireproof Data Safe
sd: Fireproof data safe protecting backup tapes, CDs, DVDs and memory sticks, tested to the Swedish NT Fire 017 standard for 60 minutes in Size 1 or 90 minutes in Size 2. Guarantee: Free Lifetime 'After the Fire' Replacement Warranty

name: Phoenix Datacombi Fireproof Paper and Data Safe
sd: Fireproof safe protecting paper documents, backup tapes and digital media with cash security in one unit. Guarantee: Free Lifetime 'After the Fire' Replacement Warranty

name: Phoenix Deep Plus & Padlock Key Cabinet with 24 to 100 Hooks
sd: Deep key cabinet with hooks spaced further apart for larger keys, full bunches and padlocks, built for the motor trade and workshops where standard hook widths pinch. name: Phoenix Deep Wall Mounted Key Cabinet for 50 to 200 Bulky Keys
sd: Deep key cabinet built for bulky keys and full bunches, ideal for the motor trade and estate agents. name: Phoenix Diamond Deposit Euro Grade 1 High Security Safe

name: Phoenix Dione Hotel Laptop and Tablet Security Safe
sd: Hotel style electronic security safe for tablets, laptops, cash and valuables, recommended for £1,000 cash or £10,000 valuables storage. name: Phoenix Fire Fighter Fireproof Document Security Safe
sd: Fireproof security safe for small and medium businesses, tested to Swedish NT Fire 017 to protect paper documents for 90 minutes in Sizes 1 and 2, and digital media such as DVDs, USB sticks and hard drives for 60 minutes. Rated for £2,500 cash or £25,000 valuables overnight, with slam shut locking and a lockable drawer.

Guarantee: Free Lifetime 'After the Fire' Replacement Warranty

name: Phoenix Fire Ranger Fireproof Filing Cupboard Safe
sd: Fireproof office safe combining fire and burglary protection in a filing cupboard format. 30 minutes of protection for paper records at 500°C, a £1,500 cash or £15,000 valuables overnight rating, high security 3 way espagnolette boltwork, and two adjustable shelves with hanging rails for lateral files as standard.

Guarantee: Free Lifetime 'After the Fire' Replacement Warranty

name: Phoenix Firechief JCQ Exam Paper Fire and Security Safe
sd: Fire and security safe tested to the European EN14450 S1 standard for £2,000 cash or £20,000 valuables cover, with 30 minutes of fire protection for paper records. Guarantee: Free Lifetime 'After the Fire' Replacement Warranty

name: Phoenix Key Store Wall Mounted Combination Key Safe
sd: Wall mounted combination key safe for door, padlock and car keys. Compact at 10cm high by 6.5cm wide, supplied with wall fixing bolts and covered by a lifetime guarantee.

name: Phoenix Lacerta Police Approved Gun Safe
sd: Police approved gun safe tested to British Standard BS7558/92, in three widths holding one, two or six guns. name: Phoenix Lockable Wall Mounted Key Box for 20 to 93 Keys
sd: Lockable wall mounted key box for the home or office, in three sizes of 20, 48 or 93 hooks. A quality key lock comes with two keys, easy to view dividers keep every set findable, and wall fixings are supplied in the box. Slim 8cm deep metal body in a scratch resistant grey powder coat finish.

name: Phoenix Red Metal Cash Box with Key Lock and Coin Divider Tray
sd: Lockable metal cash box for petty cash, takings and floats at home or in the office. Scratch resistant red powder coat finish, in a choice of 20cm, 25cm and 30cm widths.

name: Phoenix Titan 60 Minute Fireproof Home and Office Safe
sd: Compact fire and security safe for home and business, tested to NT Fire 017 for 60 minutes of paper protection and to MTC DIP120 for 60 minutes covering DVDs, USB sticks and hard drives. Rated for £2,000 cash or £20,000 valuables overnight, drop tested from 9.1 metres, with electronic, fingerprint or key locking.

Guarantee: Free Lifetime 'After the Fire' Replacement Warranty

name: Phoenix Under Counter Note Deposit Retail Cash Safe

name: Phoenix Vela Deposit Slot Home and Office Security Safe

name: Phoenix Vela Home and Office Security Safe
sd: Home and office security safe for cash, valuables and important documents, rated for £1,000 cash or £10,000 valuables overnight. name: Plaza High Back Contoured Black Leather Executive Office Chair

name: Polly One-Piece Polypropylene Stacking Visitor Chair

sd: Task operator office chair upholstered entirely in breathable mesh, seat as well as back, for a cool, suspended sit. name: Portland III High Mesh Back Task Operator Office Chair with Arms

name: Portland Medium Mesh Back Task Operator Office Chair with Arms

sd: Steel staff locker standing 178cm tall with triple locking for serious security. UK manufactured around a high grade steel carcass and supplied fully assembled, in 25 textured or gloss finishes with a choice of no shelves or 1, 4 or 6 shelf layouts. Covered by a 5 year guarantee.

name: Qube Steel Office Filing Cabinet in 25 Colours

name: Qube by Bisley Roll Out Reference Shelf in Black Steel
sd: Roll out reference shelf for the Qube by Bisley Tambour cupboard: pull it out to review filing in situ, push it silently back. 80cm wide black steel on silent glide runners, recommended for the bottom half of the unit and not compatible with the Stationery Cupboard. name: Qube by Bisley Roll Out Suspended Filing Frame in Black

name: Qube by Bisley Steel Tambour Office Cupboard
sd: Steel tambour office cupboard from Bisley, fully welded and UK manufactured, with easy-glide vertical tambour doors, high security locking and BS standard compliance. Choose 100cm or 197cm high, in Black or Goose Grey, backed by a 5 year guarantee.

name: Qube by Bisley Two Drawer Steel Filing Cabinet

name: Quote Sculpted Sled Base Office Reception Chair

sd: High mesh back ergonomic task operator chair with a luxurious cold cure foam seat, synchronised tilt with anti-shock, seat angle adjustment and a seat slide. sd: Medium mesh back task operator office chair with a twin lever infinite lock tilt, weight tension control and a choice of fold back boomerang or height adjustable arms. name: Rowan High Mesh Back Task Operator Office Chair with Headrest

name: Saturn High Mesh Back Black Executive Office Chair with Folding Arms
sd: High mesh back executive office chair with a breathable airmesh seat and a generous integral airmesh headrest. name: Savoy High Back Split Cushion Black Leather Executive Office Chair
sd: Black leather executive office chair with clean, symmetrical split backrest cushions, deeply padded for genuine comfort. name: Sch! Acoustic Wall and Hanging Screen 3 Panel Set
sd: Acoustic screen panels sold as a set of three, spanning 281cm by 242cm in 12mm PET felt made entirely from recycled materials. name: Sch! Hatch Type D Acoustic Ceiling Baffles
sd: Acoustic ceiling baffles that take the echo out of busy rooms. Class A sound absorption from 12mm PET felt made entirely from recycled materials, with Class B fire performance. name: Sch! Oblong Acoustic Desk Screen in Recycled PET Felt
sd: Acoustic desktop desk screen cut from 12mm PET felt made with 100 percent recycled materials to GRS standards. Class A sound absorption and Class B, d0 rated fire performance, designed and manufactured in the UK. Six widths from 80cm to 180cm at 40cm high, ten colours, desk clamps included and a 10 year guarantee.

name: Sch! PET Felt Acoustic Wall Tiles Set of 4

name: Sch! Patterned Acoustic Wall and Hanging Screen Panel
sd: Acoustic screen panel in 12mm PET felt made entirely from recycled materials, in ten decorative designs from Blossom to Sunburst. A generous 121cm by 242cm, wall mounted with adhesive pads or suspended on hanging wires, in ten colours with Class A sound absorption and a 10 year guarantee.

name: Sch! Rectangular Acoustic Desk Screen in Recycled PET Felt
sd: Rectangular acoustic desk screen in 12mm PET felt, made from 100 percent recycled materials certified to GRS standards. name: Sch! Shade Type C Wide Circular Acoustic Ceiling Baffles

name: Sch! Wave Acoustic Desktop Desk Divider Screen

name: Sicily Black PU Leather Folding Meeting Room Chair

name: Sigma High Mesh Back Executive Office Chair with Folding Arms
sd: Mesh back executive office chair with integral lumbar support, a height adjustable headrest and folding arms that tuck away for close desk work.
